Note: Certified Secret Friday update moment (devs are sneaky and hid the changes)

This page contains all the changes made in Version 1.46.0.

Official update log

Added

  • Some new content additions have been added to the game! Can you find them? (BHL, FHL, NT, HP)

Changes

  • Bamboo once again spawns on the beach in front of the Radical Shack.
  • Added a new set of items to Illumine Designs, above the shelf with the Property Spawn Locations:
    • Fairy Hanging Lights
    • Bulb Hanging Lights
    • Hanging Pennants
    • Neon Tube
